title: Better OneBlock [One Block]
description: A modpack created to improve the vanilla One Block experience.
body:
<center>
  
# SUMMARY

  This was a modpack designed initially for friends, but after many hours spent on making it, I decided to release it to the public so others can enjoy a Better OneBlock experience!

**Feel free to share any suggestions or report any bugs or glitches you find!**

**!!!Please backup your worlds before updating the modpack!!!**

  The Modpack is based on the Original OneBlock "Mod," where you spawn on a single grass block and are required to break it in order to progress to the next stages in which you unlock more blocks. It contains **0** structure mods, which makes the modpack very easy to update.
  
# PERFORMANCE

       _It should be_ **the most performant modpack ever!** it has more than _45 performance based mods_, it all _starts with only OneBlock_ and the other mods are small add-ons and mod libraries, with the biggest mod by far, being [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped).

# FAQ

<details>
<summary>Q: "How do I create a new world?"</summary>
A: Right now, you must use the "Re-Create" feature located under the "Create New World" Button.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Q: "Armour/Armor provides no protection/not working."</summary>
A: Protection does work! The indicator above the health bar was just hidden by a resource pack, as I see no reason to keep it on the hud. It will be moved to the inventory in the future.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Q: "Infinite durability?"</summary>
How to disable: Open your mods folder and delete the "What Durability?" mod.

Why?: Durability ends up feeling more tedious than meaningful, especially since most people use mending anyway, which effectively makes it irrelevant. This mod also makes gold tools useful!
</details>
